title: Contribution
description:
One ISIN's rupee contribution to the portfolio's total gain over a period. DERIVED, NEVER STORED. Source of truth: docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md section 10.

gain = (end_value - start_value) - net_flow, the per-holding mirror of section 5's TWRR flow adjustment, expressed as a rupee amount rather than a ratio and not annualised. Dividends count toward gain (total-return convention, matching TWRR's Candidate B decision). A holding fully exited during the period is included, with end_value 0 -- dropping it would hide the 'which investments destroyed value?' answer docs/PRODUCT_VISION.md's intelligence layer asks for.

isin.description: Securities are keyed by ISIN, never by ticker -- CLAUDE.md.

start_value.description: market_value at period start. 0 when the ISIN was not held then, never omitted.

end_value.description: market_value at as_of. 0 when the ISIN is no longer held, never omitted -- a fully exited position stays in the result with this at 0.

net_flow.description: BUY/IPO_ALLOT/TRANSFER_IN positive, SELL/TRANSFER_OUT/BUYBACK negative, DIVIDEND negative, dated within the period. Backed out of the value change so a mid-period purchase or sale is never counted as gain.

gain.description: (end_value - start_value) - net_flow. The rupee contribution to the portfolio's total gain over the period.

pct_of_total.description: gain / total_gain across every Contribution in the same response. Null only when total_gain is exactly zero. Shown uncapped otherwise -- including negative and above-100% values when holdings offset -- never normalised or clipped.
